annotations.title: Check a LinkedIn headline and About section

description: Checks the LinkedIn headline and About section (and, optionally, the top experience entry) of a project, program or product manager, TPM or PMO lead. Use it when someone asks to review or improve their LinkedIn profile for recruiters. Checks the 220 character headline limit, the role title and searchable keywords, filler, what About shows before see more, figures and named scope, first person, personal details in public text, and whether the titles agree. Returns up to 10 findings in the order of risk, each with the line, the question a recruiter may ask and a direction, plus a score per section. It does not rewrite the text. English text; contact details are removed first; nothing is stored.

about_en.description: Only when the profile is not in English: a literal English translation of the About section, word for word, with no fact added or left out and figures and names as written.
about_en.title: About En

experience.description: Optional. The top experience entry: the title line, then its description.
experience.title: Experience

experience_en.description: Only when the profile is not in English: a literal English translation of the top experience entry, word for word, with no fact added or left out and figures and names as written.
experience_en.title: Experience En

headline.description: The LinkedIn headline as written. At least the headline or the About section is needed.
headline.title: Headline

headline_en.description: Only when the profile is not in English: a literal English translation of the headline, word for word, with no fact added or left out and figures and names as written.
headline_en.title: Headline En

lang.description: The language the person writes in, as a code such as es, fr or ru; empty or en for English. The result names this language; findings are written in English.

role.description: Optional. One of project-manager, program-manager, technical-program-manager, product-manager, scrum-master, pmo, it-manager, business-analyst, delivery-manager; a title as written (for example Senior Program Manager) is also read. Empty when not sure.
